description: Use when someone asks what size rug fits their living room or goes under or in front of their sofa. Returns the UK and US stock rug sizes that run past each end of the sofa and leave bare floor to the walls.

armchairs.description: none, or two armchairs facing the sofa, which the rug must also reach.

legs_on_rug.description: Which sofa legs stand on the rug: all, front (the usual choice) or none (the rug sits under the coffee table only).

room_length_cm.description: The room’s length, out from the sofa wall (cm).

room_width_cm.description: The room’s width along the wall the sofa stands against (cm).

sofa_depth_cm.description: The sofa’s depth, back to front (cm).

sofa_width_cm.description: The sofa’s width, arm to arm (cm).

name: rug_size

least_floor_cm.description: The least bare floor between rug and wall

needed.description: The rug the rule asks for: width_cm, ideal_width_cm, depth_cm

plan.description: Where things sit, out from the sofa wall: rug_from_cm, table_from_cm, table_length_cm, chairs_from_cm

uk_rug.description: A stock rug: name, width_cm (along the sofa), depth_cm, turned, meets_rule, past_sofa_end_cm (negative: short of the sofa), floor_each_side_cm, floor_far_end_cm, sofa_share. The smallest UK size that meets the rule and fits the room, else the closest that fits; null if none fits

us_rug.description: A stock rug: name, width_cm (along the sofa), depth_cm, turned, meets_rule, past_sofa_end_cm (negative: short of the sofa), floor_each_side_cm, floor_far_end_cm, sofa_share. The same for US sizes (in feet)
